items.title: Introducing Claude for Small Business
items.summary_1line: We're launching Claude for Small Business, a package of connectors and ready-to-run workflows that put Claude inside the tools small businesses use every day.
items.editor_note: Initial launch: packaged connectors and workflows for small business owners.

items.title: What 1,000 small business owners taught us about AI | Claude by Anthropic
items.summary_1line: Lina Ochman, Head of U.S. SMB at Anthropic, shares what she learned during our Claude Small Business Tour, and what’s next for the program.
items.editor_note: Field research from the SMB tour on what blocks non-technical owners from adopting AI.

items.title: Claude for Small Business launches new workflows, integrations, and training programs | Claude by Anthropic
items.summary_1line: We’re releasing new Claude for Small Business workflows and integrations to help owners run and grow their business, and kicking off the next leg of our Claude SMB Tour.
items.editor_note: Follow-on release: new workflows, integrations, and training, plus the tour's next leg.

editorial.tldr: Anthropic launched Claude for Small Business in late August with prebuilt connectors and ready-to-run workflows aimed at owners without technical staff. A nationwide SMB tour through September fed owner feedback straight back into the product.
editorial.whats_new: Anthropic shipped new Claude for Small Business workflows, integrations, and training programs on Sep 15 and kicked off the next leg of its SMB tour.
editorial.why_it_matters: It's a live case study in packaging agents for non-technical buyers: ship connectors instead of a raw API, then run a direct feedback loop before iterating.
editorial.take_for_builders: Selling agent workflows to non-technical buyers: package prebuilt connectors instead of a raw API, and run a direct feedback loop with real customers before your next integration push.

status.detail: Anthropic is iterating on the small-business product in public, pairing each release with direct owner outreach.
